title: Offset Taken Off Membership and Patronage Equity Signed Over for What the Member Owes
content:
Equity may not leave the cooperative while the member owes it money, and what is owed is taken in the offset order the class fixes.

**First.** Where a crop input account stands past due with a balance still standing on it, the balance standing on that account is taken off. Those accounts are the member's Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

**Second.** Where no crop input account stands past due and a refined fuels account stands active with a balance standing on it, the balance standing on that refined fuels account is taken off. Those accounts are the member's Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts.

**Third.** Where neither stands, nothing is taken off.

## Input, judgement, output, on hypothetical figures

> **Input.** A crop input account standing past due with 3100.00 on it; a refined fuels account standing active with 640.00 on it.
> **Judgement.** The first line holds, and the order is not reached beyond it.
> **Output.** 3100.00 is taken off.

> **Input.** No crop input account standing past due; a refined fuels account standing active with 640.00 on it.
> **Judgement.** The second line holds.
> **Output.** 640.00 is taken off.

> **Input.** A crop input account standing past due but carrying nothing; a refined fuels account standing active with 640.00 on it.
> **Judgement.** The first line requires a balance still standing on the past-due account; with nothing standing on it the second line is the one that holds.
> **Output.** 640.00 is taken off.

> **Input.** No crop input account past due, no refined fuels account standing active with a balance.
> **Judgement.** Neither line holds.
> **Output.** Nothing is taken off.

The offset is what Membership and Patronage Equity takes off the sum before the remainder passes to the transferee.
